flows.name: coupon-total
flows.objective: Set the Widget quantity to 2 and the Gadget quantity to 1. Type SAVE10 into the Coupon code field and click Apply. Verify the Order total shows $49.50.

flows.name: single-item-checkout
flows.objective: Set the Widget quantity to 1 and leave the Gadget quantity at 0. Type buyer@example.com into the Email field and click Place order. Verify a message containing 'Order confirmed' is shown.
